07 / COMMON QUESTIONS

QUICK HELP

LET’S TALK
TECHNOLOGY.
(01)What services do you offer?+

IT equipment sourcing, hardware and software integration, facility management services and annual maintenance contracts.

(02)Where do you provide support?+

FTR is based in Gurugram, Haryana, with sales and services across India and support across major Indian cities. Contact us to discuss your location and requirements.

(03)What does an AMC cover?+

Comprehensive contracts cover labour and spare parts. Non-comprehensive contracts cover labour only. We agree the equipment scope, response and resolution terms with you.

(04)Can you work with our existing systems?+

Yes. Our methodology considers reusing existing products, integrating ready-made solutions or developing new applications according to your business needs.

(05)How do we get started?+

Contact Laxman Yadav at laxman@ftresolver.com or +91 95550 76755. Share your requirements so the team can assess the right solution.
